design_ancestry_signals.summary: A new object/system appears abruptly and changes the local rules before its origin or purpose is understood.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Model significant arrivals as source-preserved events with separate arrival, interpretation, quarantine, and adoption stages.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Temporal disturbances deposit people and objects from other worlds/times into bounded arrival zones.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Universal Codex portals and ingest surfaces can receive provenance-bearing objects from multiple worlds without collapsing them into one canon.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Participants may shift into an unstable shadow/flux state and may or may not return cleanly.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Use explicit transitional presence states for unstable, partial, remote, quarantined, or unresolved manifestations instead of binary present/absent.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Controls respond more strongly to a particular mode of contact, but interaction remains partial, costly, and difficult to interpret.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Permit gesture, voice, ink, haptic, or model-specific interaction affinities while keeping capability confidence, interpretation confidence, and cost separate.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Some consoles and sections are active, some dead, some locked, and some functions remain automatic.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Projected OS maps should show discovered, unavailable, locked, degraded, automatic, and unknown organs as distinct states.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Dedicated research rooms can be sealed and isolated for risky or incompatible material.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Quarantine and Proving Chamber spaces may be rendered as visibly bounded containers with ingress/egress receipts and scope-limited authority.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: One station contains distinct controlled ecological zones and climates maintained by the system itself.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Treat rooms/worlds as different environmental projection profiles sharing one substrate without flattening their local rules.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Time spent in an environment progressively changes participant state, with recovery requiring leaving or returning to a baseline zone.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Track interaction load, session intensity, adaptation, and cooldown as explicit state rather than hiding cumulative effects.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Participants can leave a bounded system temporarily but must return before a deadline or suffer escalating consequences.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Represent time-limited leases, dependency windows, return requirements, and expiry separately from identity and location.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Several explanations for the same anomaly coexist while the underlying cause remains unresolved.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Observer should preserve competing causal hypotheses with status/evidence rather than selecting one explanatory story prematurely.

candidate_ui.station_machine: arrival -> anomaly field -> partial interface discovery -> room/zone mapping -> exposure tracking -> scoped investigation -> competing hypotheses -> receipt
visuals: station organs lighting according to discovered/locked/dead/automatic state
flicker silhouettes for unstable presence states
timestorm/rift ingress rendered as incoming provenance ribbons
sealed research rooms as floating bounded cells
exposure clock or halo that accumulates without changing identity
hypothesis cards orbiting one observation without auto-merging

laws: Unknown interface semantics remain unknown until learned.
Partial control does not imply system ownership.
Exposure state belongs in the receipt.
Multiple hypotheses may remain live at once.
A bounded world may have local rules without becoming universal law.
